meta.note: frame = rect in atlas; offset = where the rect goes inside the 256x256 cell; flip_x = draw the rect mirrored horizontally (offset_x already refers to the mirrored placement); page = index into meta.pages (which atlas PNG the rect is in; missing = 0)

hit_boxes.note: x0, y0, x1, y1 in 256-cell px; tail of the front idle pose (mirror x when the frame is drawn flipped); belly = apron / tummy of the front idle pose (same anims, same mirroring rule)

idle_blink_half.notes: idle with half-closed eyes, index-synced with idle

idle_blink_closed.notes: idle with closed eyes, index-synced with idle

blink.notes: blink overlaid on idle frames 0-5 (the app swaps in idle_blink_* at the current idle index)

happy_jump.notes: anticipation squash -> stretch -> air -> land squash -> settle

angry.notes: pout, puffed cheeks, stomping, pulsing anger mark

sad_cry.notes: teary eyes + animated tear streams, sobbing hitch, drooped head/ahoge/tail

surprised.notes: startle hop with ! mark; holds on the last frame

dangle.notes: held by the head: pendulum swing (shear about the top), legs hang

fall.notes: falling: slight stretch, hair/tail blown up

land.notes: impact squash -> rebound stretch -> settle into idle pose

walk_left.notes: layered walk: AI passing-key body + AI stance leg cut out as layers; hip/ankle rotation cycle contact-down-passing-up (8 clean poses, no cross-fades), far leg darker; the upper body is one rigid layer moved only by an integer body bob (no hair / hem / tail warps)

petted.notes: AI keys: hands clasped/eyes closed <-> hands on cheeks laughing; head wiggle, hearts

petted_end.notes: AI key: holding the apron, smiling (exit pose after petting)

sleepy.notes: idle -> AI yawn -> AI sit (procedural head dips + painted eyelids closing) -> AI lie down

sleep.notes: AI lying pose hugging the whale plush: slow breathing + rising zzz

wake.notes: AI lie -> AI sit, eyes open (painted lids) -> stand; the app follows with surprised

sit.notes: AI sitting pose: breathing, hair sway, one painted-eyelid blink per loop

wave.notes: AI wave A <-> B with optical-flow in-betweens, body sway

curtsy.notes: idle -> AI curtsy (knee dip = explicit squash + head dip) -> idle

stretch.notes: idle -> AI stretch, arms up (explicit stretch, hold with a tremble) -> idle

tea.notes: AI tea-sipping pose: sip (head tips back), breathing, rising steam

dance.notes: AI dance pose <-> its mirror; turn frames = horizontal squash (+ canonical back view), sparkles

trip.notes: walking left -> stumble -> AI tripped/sitting-crying pose (sobs) -> gets up (sad -> neutral)

curious.notes: AI curious pose (finger on chin) looking one way, then mirrored; bobbing ? mark

tsun_hmph.notes: idle -> AI arms-crossed turn-away pose (hmph): huff loop (squash hitch + 'hmph' puff from the nose, pulsing anger mark, blush) -> idle; the loop_section frames repeat while the app holds the state

tsun_proud.notes: idle -> AI hands-on-hips pose, chin up (flustered denial): chin-up stretch bob, blush pulse, one painted-eyelid blink -> idle

tsun_peek.notes: AI peeking pose (fiddling with her hair) with painted eyelids: pretends to look away (eyes shut) and sneaks half-open peeks (loop_section) -> eyes open -> caught: '!' + hop -> AI arms-crossed hmph -> idle

tsun_point.notes: idle -> AI flustered pointing pose ('stop poking!'): 1 px rigid jitter, sweat drops, anger mark, blush -> idle

poke_screen.notes: idle -> AI leaning-in poke pose: three taps on the screen glass (lean-in = uniform scale pulse, ripple at the fingertip) -> idle

eat_taiyaki.notes: idle -> AI taiyaki pose (both hands, cheeks full): chewing loop (rigid cheek squash), falling crumbs, sparkles -> idle

praised_shy.notes: idle -> AI shy pose after praise (holding the apron, looking down): soft sway (whole-body shear), steam puffs from the head, blush pulse -> idle

gift_cookie.notes: idle -> AI offering-a-heart-cookie pose (looking away, blushing): hold (loop_section) -> small hop with a heart -> idle

dangle_tsun.notes: dragged for more than 3 s: AI flustered pointing pose dangling from the head (pendulum shear about the top + 1 px rigid shake), sweat, anger mark

idle_tea.notes: idle -> AI teapot pose (wisp from the spout) -> pours into the cup on a tray (tea drops) -> blows on the cup (breath lines, steam) -> sips, eyes closed (loop_section: content bob, blush pulse, rising note, steam) -> idle

idle_fishing.notes: idle -> AI fishing: rod raised (bobber dangling) -> wind-up lean -> cast (the bobber flies into a small puddle, splash) -> sits on a stool, sleepy (loop_section: bobbing float, ripple rings, a nibble, zzz) -> bite: float dips, '!' -> stands up holding the fish (wiggling, drops, sparkles) -> idle

idle_butterfly.notes: idle -> a butterfly flutters in; AI look-up pose, hand raised (it circles above the hand) -> crouching sneak -> jump (cut to the AI jump pose, airborne arc) and catch -> lands, it rests on her fingertip (loop_section: slow wing flaps, blush, sparkle) -> it flies off (heart) -> idle

idle_butterfly_miss.notes: same start as idle_butterfly (look up -> sneak -> jump), but the butterfly escapes over her hands -> lands in the AI arms-crossed pose (loop_section: hmph huffs + puff, blush) -> idle

ds_rice_slurp.notes: idle -> AI heaped-rice-bowl pose (starry eyes, drool, steam) -> cut: face in the bowl, slurp loop (loop_section: rigid cheek squash, rice grains whirling into the mouth) -> cut: empty bowl, burp puff, grain on the cheek -> idle

ds_basin.notes: idle -> AI solemn basin-lift pose (two lift bobs) -> cut: basin on the head, hands on hips, smug (loop_section: sparkles twinkle, sway, blush) -> cut: the basin slips over her eyes, flustered wobble (rigid shear + 1 px shake, sweat) -> idle with a pop cloud (basin removed)

ds_token_nibble.notes: only after the user has been idle for a while: idle -> AI nibbling-a-glowing-gold-coin pose (loop_section: nibble squash, glow rays, falling gold crumbs, sparkle) -> idle; the app hard-cuts to ds_token_hide when the cursor moves

ds_token_hide.notes: caught nibbling: hard cut -> AI hands-behind-back pose, looking away, whistling (loop_section: '♪' notes, sweat drop, sway, blush) -> idle

ds_tail_touch.notes: tail clicked: idle -> cut to the AI turned-away grab-own-tail pose (teary glare, '!', trembling, anger mark) -> cut: fists + puffed cheeks, tail slam loop (loop_section = one slam: tail up with speed lines -> slammed down, dust puffs; the app holds it for 2-3 slams) -> idle

ds_beg_rice.notes: hungry: idle -> AI holding-the-empty-bowl-forward begging pose (loop_section: starry-eye sparkle pulse, small bounce, blush) -> idle

ds_bowl_sulk.notes: begging ignored: idle -> AI sulking pose, empty rice bowl upside-down on the head, arms crossed (loop_section: huff puffs, anger mark, blush) -> idle with a pop cloud (bowl removed)

ds_not_fat.notes: belly clicked: idle -> cut to the AI teary stomp-protest pose (fists, '!') -> stomp loop (loop_section = one stomp: rigid hop + slam squash, floor dust both sides, anger mark; the app holds it for 2-3 stomps) -> hard cut: turned away secretly nibbling an onigiri (2 nibble cycles, rice crumbs) -> idle

ds_deep_think.notes: idle -> cut to the AI finger-on-chin thinking pose with a thought cloud (sheet prop): '…' dots fill up (已深度思考…) -> cut: teary-dreamy pose, the cloud is now a rice bowl (loop_section: slow bob, the cloud floats, twinkles, blush) -> hard cut to idle + a quick rigid head shake (whole-image offsets), the cloud pops away, sweat (才、才没有在想吃的！) -> idle

ds_outsource_nap.notes: idle -> cut to the AI folding-a-paper-airplane pose (press squashes) -> cut: throw (the airplane is the sheet prop, it flies off over the left canvas edge with speed lines; 这活交给别人了～) -> cut: plopped on the floor asleep hugging the steel pot (loop_section: slow rigid breathing + procedural 'z z'; the app holds it 6-12 s, a click wakes her) -> wake: hard cut to the AI stretch pose (reused) -> idle with a slow blink

ds_server_busy.notes: click spam: idle -> cut to the AI dizzy swirl-eye pose holding a sign overhead; the sign text 服务器繁忙 / 请稍后再试 is rendered (Noto Sans CJK Bold, navy) and mapped onto the sign quad (loop_section: integer-px dizzy bob, circling stars, sweat drops; clicks are ignored) -> small bounce back to idle (好、好了，恢复服务！)

ds_shock_sit.notes: idle -> hard cut to the AI frozen-shock pose (blank eyes, hands up, '!', 1 px shake; 欸——？！) -> cut: plopped sitting in shock, squash pop + floor dust (loop_section: a cute little soul puff sways above her head; held 1.5-2.5 s) -> the puff zips back -> AI hop-up pose, rigid head shake in the air, sweat -> land -> idle
